LESSON: THE EARLY CHURCH

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 5.2: The Early Church

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about The Early Church. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How was the early church started?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. name the disciples of Jesus Christ
2. describe how the early church was started

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. name the disciples of Jesus Christ
   In simple words: practise until you can name the disciples of Jesus Christ. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. describe how the early church was started
   In simple words: practise until you can describe how the early church was started. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about The Early Church using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about The Early Church in the examples.
2. Explain The Early Church to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The Early Church.
4. Show that you can: name the disciples of Jesus Christ

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Early Church using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is The Early Church important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read Matthew 10:1-4 and list the disciples of Jesus Christ,
2. Sort the names of the 12 disciples using flash cards,
3. Read Acts 2:38-41 on how the early church was started,
4. Role-play how the early church was started,
5. Mathematics: mathematical skills are applied as learners use flash cards to sort the names of the 12 disciples.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. name the disciples of Jesus Christ
2. describe how the early church was started

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
